products.name: Appex Studio ANC Wireless Headphones
products.description: Hybrid active noise cancellation up to 42dB, 40mm dynamic drivers, 50-hour battery life with USB-C fast charging, and memory-foam protein leather ear cushions.

reviews.author: Rohan Mehta
reviews.comment: Clean acoustic separation and super comfortable during long work calls.

reviews.author: Ananya Iyer
reviews.comment: Battery easily lasts a full week of commuting. Great build finish.

products.name: Chronos Steel Hybrid Smartwatch
products.description: Brushed 316L stainless steel bezel with AMOLED display, stitched full-grain espresso leather strap, continuous heart-rate tracking, and 5ATM water resistance.

reviews.author: Vikram Nair
reviews.comment: Looks like an heirloom analog watch while tracking workouts accurately.

products.name: Stride Knit Road Runners — Slate
products.description: Breathable engineered mesh upper paired with dual-density EVA midsole cushioning and high-abrasion carbon rubber traction outsole for daily road mileage.

reviews.author: Siddharth Rao
reviews.comment: Lightweight on morning 5Ks and pairs well with casual denim.

products.name: Heavyweight Organic Twill Overshirt
products.description: 340 GSM garment-washed organic cotton twill overshirt in deep navy. Features twin chest utility pockets, reinforced felled seams, and natural horn buttons.

reviews.author: Kabir Verma
reviews.comment: Heavy fabric drapes sharply. True to size across the shoulders.

products.name: Sculpted Ceramic & Brass Table Lamp
products.description: Hand-finished matte ivory stoneware base paired with a brushed solid brass collar, natural woven linen drum shade, and braided fabric power cord (E27 warm LED included).

reviews.author: Meera Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Throws a calm warm glow across my study desk. Packaging was rock solid.

products.name: Ballistic Commuter 22L Backpack
products.description: Water-resistant 1680D ballistic nylon commuter pack with full-grain leather trim, suspended 16-inch padded laptop sleeve, and YKK AquaGuard zippers.

reviews.author: Devika Sen
reviews.comment: Stands upright on its own and holds my laptop plus camera pouch cleanly.
